experiment_class: non-confirmatory engineering comparison on already-inspected bundled ETFs
input_data_role: existing QuantConnect bundled SPY/QQQ/IWM prices, dates, volumes and factors; no acquisition, PIT universe or original availability acceptance

folds.selection_boundary: Training label exit at t+6 must precede first evaluation decision; additionally censor evaluation labels past their own fold boundary.
folds.forecast_origin: Each fold's final available training close; forecast purge + 5 sessions and score only first 5 test closes.
folds.comparison_rows: Same asset/fold test dates for every candidate and naive. No reserved 2021Q1 inference or retuning.

error: MASE using mean absolute training first differences
forecast.interval: Mean paired fold-level absolute-error differences; arch StationaryBootstrap block size 3, 999 reps, seed260410, 95% percentile interval. No independent-fold or superiority assumption.
forecast.chronos: Native CPU pipeline median quantile; all model training provenance remains unknown.

candidate_runs.alphalens: Native factor cleaning and five-session raw forward returns with filter_zscore=None, no look-ahead zscore clipping; 3 quantiles for 3 ETFs; per-date factor IC and before-training-boundary slices.
candidate_runs.arch: Native constant-mean GARCH(1,1) fit on percent daily returns; forecast variance and fixed block bootstrap interval.
candidate_runs.statsmodels: Native ARIMA(1,1,0) fit/forecast at exact same origin.
candidate_runs.statsforecast: Native AutoARIMA forecast at exact same origin, n_jobs=1.
candidate_runs.skfolio: Original1.2.9 WalkForward comparison zero/horizon purge and current1.8.1 CPCV purge/embargo sensitivity.
candidate_runs.claude_trading_skills: Upstream supplied backtest-expert CLI and its own tests, seeded summary red flags/clean controls. The numeric CLI cannot inspect latent look-ahead input data; record missed defects rather than claim it detects them.

gap_boundaries.0: Genuine dividends/cash engine run required; selected-ETF PIT-universe portion stays open.
gap_boundaries.1: Scope to reproduced chronology and embargo controls, never statistical independence.
gap_boundaries.5: Only actual vendor calls credited; fifteen-candidate statement stays open until all required executions exist.
gap_boundaries.6: Executed same-input candidate comparison, no assumed ranking.
gap_boundaries.7: c13/c16 require real native invocation, source read is insufficient.
gap_boundaries.9: Execution-broker/account owner only; no broker operation in this lane.
gap_boundaries.10: Dividend, fees, financing/capacity portions remain explicit; no synthetic accounting substituted.
gap_boundaries.13: Retain loss intervals and negative/inconclusive outcomes; no manufactured superiority.
gap_boundaries.14: Retain c13 found and missed seeded defects and c16 naive comparison.
